name: diplomatic relation towards
description: Official diplomatic stance of FROM towards TO: -100 = hostile, relations broken off, 0 = neutral or no meaningful relations, 100 = closest allies.

name: social view towards
description: How the population of FROM views TO: -100 = hatred, 0 = indifference, 100 = strong sympathy.

name: perceived subordination towards
description: How dependent FROM believes it is on TO: 100 = FROM sees itself as TO's vassal, 0 = independent or equal, -100 = FROM sees TO as its own vassal.

name: perceived power towards
description: How strongly FROM believes it can influence TO (economically, politically, militarily): 0 = no influence, 100 = decisive influence, negative = FROM believes its actions towards TO backfire.

name: real subordination towards
description: Actual dependence of FROM on TO (same scale as perceived subordination towards), as judged by an outside observer.

name: real power towards
description: Actual ability of FROM to influence TO (same scale as perceived power towards), as judged by an outside observer; not symmetric (FROM->TO differs from TO->FROM).

name: economic dependence
description: How much the economy of FROM depends on TO (trade, energy, finance, remittances): 0 = none, 50 = a crisis in TO clearly hurts FROM, 100 = FROM's economy cannot function without TO. Drives how crises spread in the engine's second (external) turn.
